name: One Lewd World
source:
In One lewd World you play as John, a lonely man looking to escape his mundane life through virtual reality. Through some twist of fate, you find yourself inside a very lewd virtual reality game in a female avatar called Ava. To your surprise, you find that all the NPC's in this game seem to be very hung futas. Is this a blessing or a curse? Should you leave or are you a little curious?

[From F95zone]
